interest: Conscription rumors caused panic among Chinese in Tsingtao.
overview: 1939 reports on Japanese conscription of Chinese youths and the panic in Tsingtao.

subfiles.about: Reports intelligence alleging that Japanese authorities are conscripting Chinese youths aged 17 to 25 for military training.
subfiles.summary: Naval Attaché in Peiping reports Japan conscripting Chinese men aged 17 to 25.
subfiles.title: Telegram from ALUSNA Peiping on Japanese Conscription of Chinese Youths

subfiles.about: Cross-references a consular report from Tsingtao regarding rumors of Japanese conscription of young Chinese men.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to Sokobin's despatch on rumored conscription in Tsingtao.
subfiles.title: Cross-Reference Sheet for Tsingtao Despatch No. 426 on Rumored Japanese Conscription

subfiles.about: Reports on civilian panic, business disruption, and police denials triggered by rumors of Japanese conscription in Tsingtao.
subfiles.summary: Conscription rumors caused an exodus of workers from Tsingtao; the consul thought conscription unlikely.
subfiles.title: Report Extract on Alarm Caused by Rumors of Japanese Conscription in Tsingtao
